description: This file defines a class 'TransformationText' that demonstrates various graphics transformations such as translation, scaling, rotation, and skewing using the PdfSharp library. It contains a method 'RenderSnippet' which draws axes, applies transformations, and renders text accordingly to illustrate the effects of each transformation.

classes.name: TransformationText
classes.description: A class that inherits from Snippet, illustrating transformations applied to text rendering within a PDF using PdfSharp library.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders a series of text and line transformations to demonstrate translation, scaling, rotation, and skewing effects on text within a PDF graphics context.
